items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I came back on the train with my Aunt Lucy

ctx.x: What did you do? Drive back alone?

No, I came back on the train with my Aunt Lucy, who didn’t speak English. It was a very interesting experience, because this time I got to see the country in a different way, through the windows of a train. It took – I guess it took something like two or three days. I can’t remember. I ought to look that up, because it’s part of Americana that I’ve lived through, and I should know just how long it took. My particular . . .
